causal_hypothesis: A target-independent one-time clarification fallback can acquire missing information when P5 returns recommendations without a useful question after repeated negative feedback, while preserving P5 retrieval, ranking, routing, state, recommendations, usage, and existing questions.

selected_residual_family.label: remaining insufficient dialogue
selected_residual_family.restriction: The four diagnosed sessions are supporting aggregate evidence only and may not appear in runtime logic or proxy selection.

documentation_limit.known: Official participant documentation states that the public set has 200 sessions across Buying, Browsing, Intent Override, and Boundary, the frozen catalog has 50,000 Clothing/Shoes/Jewelry products, and the organizer has an additional private 800-session set.
documentation_limit.unknown: The documentation does not specify private target category, popularity, or scenario proportions, nor a target sampling algorithm.
documentation_limit.consequence: Neither proxy distribution is described as the actual private distribution. Development and confirmation are catalog-stratified transfer proxies; the third set is explicitly a uniform-target stress test.

common_eligibility: not present in data/public_set.jsonl ground-truth targets
official evaluator intent_card and materialize_hidden_fields helpers execute without exception
no target identity is emitted outside benchmark-local generation; artifacts retain only aggregate counts and hashes

development.scenario_assignment: Sort selected targets by SHA-256(seed, parent_asin), then assign exactly 100 each in the repeating order boundary, browsing, buying, intent_override.
development.selection: Stratify the eligible catalog by official coarse_category and catalog-wide popularity quartile, where popularity is log1p(max(0,rating_number)); allocate 400 slots proportional to stratum sizes using largest remainders with deterministic stratum-name ties; within each stratum choose the lowest SHA-256(seed,parent_asin); fill any unavailable allocation globally by the same hash order.
development.availability: Generated only after this predeclaration commit.

confirmation.scenario_assignment: Same balanced deterministic assignment as development.
confirmation.selection: Apply the identical catalog-stratified allocation after excluding public and development targets; use the confirmation seed for within-stratum ordering.
confirmation.availability: Target identities and outcomes remain untouched until one frozen development variant qualifies.

uniform_stress.scenario_assignment: Same balanced deterministic assignment as development.
uniform_stress.selection: After excluding public, development, and confirmation targets, choose the lowest SHA-256(seed,parent_asin) over the entire eligible pool without category or popularity stratification.
uniform_stress.interpretation: A hash-uniform eligible-catalog stress test, not a private-score estimate.
uniform_stress.availability: Not evaluated unless confirmation gates pass.

proxy_sets.disjointness_proof: Record public/development/confirmation/stress set intersections, per-set target-selection SHA-256, combined target-selection SHA-256, category counts, popularity-quartile counts, and scenario counts. Every required intersection must be zero.

answerability_derivation.catalog_scope: Traverse all 50,000 official catalog products in parent_asin order; no public outcomes or session labels are consulted.
answerability_derivation.answerability_rate: For each official ask_attribute, fraction of catalog intent cards for which official customer_reply would return at least one undisclosed matching hard/soft constraint. For other, any nonempty constraint list is answerable.
answerability_derivation.constraint_yield: Mean min(2, matching constraint count) over all products and separately over answerable products, matching official customer_reply's two-constraint cap.
answerability_derivation.excluded_attributes: Exclude attributes with zero answerability or no existing bounded-catalog ambiguity statistic. Category and brand are expected to be excluded because official customer_reply does not materialize them as hard/soft constraints; size is excluded unless both positive simulator answerability and an existing bounded ambiguity statistic are available without changing P5.
answerability_derivation.ambiguity_threshold: Group the full catalog by official coarse_category, sort each group by SHA-256(derivation seed,parent_asin), partition into nonoverlapping blocks of 50 (discard blocks below four), compute each block's maximum positive expected_reduction over retained runtime attributes, then take the median and floor to three decimals. This single derived threshold is shared by A and B.
answerability_derivation.rounding: Answerability rates and mean yields use round-half-even to six decimals; the ambiguity threshold is floored to three decimals. Runtime constants must exactly match the artifact under this rule.
answerability_derivation.rejection: Reject Variant B if these aggregates cannot be derived without public outcomes or if no targeted attribute retains positive answerability and bounded ambiguity support.

eligibility: P5 has already produced the turn response and ask_attribute is null
the current runtime-observable message matches P5's existing finite negative-feedback expression
the existing bounded P5 analysis pool has at least four candidates
the session has not used a P8 fallback
the P5 clarification controller has no pending question and has not exhausted its existing two-question cap
the selected attribute is not asked, answered, declined, pending, or already known
at least one unresolved retained attribute has expected_reduction at or above the catalog-derived ambiguity threshold
shared_fallback.intervention: Attach exactly one existing schema-valid clarification prompt while deep-preserving P5 recommendations, recommendation order, scores, usage, and all unrelated response fields.
shared_fallback.failure_behavior: Any missing catalog record, malformed metadata, invalid statistic, controller refusal, or exception returns the exact unmodified P5 response and records a diagnostic failure; it never scans the full catalog at response time.
shared_fallback.disabled_behavior: The disabled policy must be byte-for-byte and hash-identical to P5.

A.label: one-time open fallback
A.selection: If shared eligibility passes and other is neither known nor present in any controller history set, request other using the existing prompt template.
A.configuration: No target-derived weight or threshold beyond the shared catalog-derived ambiguity threshold.

B.label: one-time expected-utility attribute fallback
B.selection: For each retained unanswered attribute, compute answerability_rate * mean_constraint_yield_when_answerable * current bounded-pool expected_reduction; choose the strictly highest positive score with alphabetical attribute tie-break, mapping price ambiguity to budget. Require that attribute's expected_reduction to meet the shared threshold.
B.configuration: Use only the rounded catalog-wide answerability/yield constants from the derivation artifact; no additive weights, public outcomes, or session-specific constants.

paired_bootstrap.multiplicity_note: Two candidate variants require the selected variant's two-sided 97.5% interval and probability-positive threshold 0.9875.

development_protocol.selection_rule: Select the qualifying variant with the larger paired TechnicalScore delta; tie-break by fewer fallback questions, then A before B. If neither qualifies, reject P8 immediately. Do not tune either variant after outcomes.
development_protocol.determinism: Record hashes for all runs. Repeat only a provisionally qualifying variant and exact P5 before selection; any mismatch rejects P8.

confirmation_protocol.paraphrase_replay: On the same confirmation targets, deterministically apply only case and terminal punctuation/em-dash perturbations to official helper-generated user messages; preserve hidden cards, customer answers, scenarios, and target selection.
confirmation_protocol.uniform_stress_rejection: Reject for mechanism reversal defined as TechnicalScore delta <= -0.010, HR@10 delta < -0.020, or any scenario TechnicalScore delta < -0.020. Smaller losses are reported as stress limitations.

public_shadow_protocol.suite: Existing 64-session public-target-disjoint participant shadow protocol, seed 20260830; exactly one selected P8 candidate and exact P5.

official_protocol.run_1: Only after all prior gates pass: verify evaluator/public fingerprints and isolated runtime diff, then run untouched evaluator once. Require +0.015 TechnicalScore, positive 95% CI, probability positive >=0.975, HR nondecrease, positive net hits, scenario regression no worse than -0.005, MTTC nonworsening, attribution, and zero failures.
official_protocol.run_2: Only after run 1 passes: repeat the identical frozen candidate and require identical non-timing metrics, normalized responses, questions, recommendations, usage, failure counters, response hash, and session hash.

resource_limits.p95_response_latency_ms: no more than max(1000, 2 * same-set P5 p95)

allowed_runtime_inputs: existing bounded P5 candidates and catalog metadata
existing active state and clarification-controller snapshot
forbidden_runtime_inputs_or_changes: public or proxy target IDs, aliases, labels, outcomes, or lookup tables
hidden scenario labels or future turns
reference checkout, snapshots, constants, control flow, or artifacts
P5 retrieval, ranking, filtering, routing, state semantics, existing question policy, recommendation width, P3, or P7
official evaluator, public set, simulator, metric, target labels, or stopping behavior

risk_and_transfer.public_overfitting_risk: P5 and residual-family motivation include public-development evidence, so P8 selection is prohibited from consulting public shadow until both independent proxies pass; runtime constants come only from catalog-wide aggregates.
risk_and_transfer.private_transfer_hypothesis: Missing-information acquisition conditioned on bounded candidate ambiguity and explicit negative feedback should transfer across catalog targets because it uses official simulator answerability and no target identity; distribution mismatch remains unquantified.
primary_risks: extra turn cost without useful answer

stop_rule: Stop immediately at the first frozen phase gate failure, restore exact P5 runtime, consume no unauthorized official run, package P5, and do not begin P9.
